page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, the instance provides 64 vCPUs. The system configuration features 256.0 GB of memory, yielding a 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per virtual core.

The instance lacks local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data needs. Network throughput is supported up to a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Lacking GPU acceleration, the resource profile is suited for general-purpose application servers, enterprise backend processes, high-frequency compute workloads, build environments, and web serving clusters.
